Detailed Itinerary of the Tour

  • Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel and take you to our bicycle parking lot, where you can select a suitable bike for your ride.
  • We will start cycling through the Old Quarter, riding through narrow streets before crossing the Red River via Long Bien Bridge the oldest bridge in Hanoi, built during the French colonial era over 100 years ago. Enjoy scenic views of the Red River, watch the boats float beneath, and observe the green vegetable farms on the island.
  • We will start cycling through the Old Quarter, riding through narrow streets before crossing the Red River via Long Bien Bridge the oldest bridge in Hanoi, built during the French colonial era over 100 years ago. Enjoy scenic views of the Red River, watch the boats float beneath, and observe the green vegetable farms on the island.
  • We will then cycle into the island countryside, where local farmers live and work, offering a glimpse into their daily lives. Here, you will have the opportunity to visit a family living on a floating house on the Red River. You can learn about their way of life and traditions, with our guide helping facilitate interaction with the family.
  • Continuing our journey, we will cycle through dirt roads and rural villages, heading toward various farms. Enjoy the vast green landscapes, including corn farms, banana farms, and vegetable farms, where you’ll meet the farmers and engage in conversations to better understand their daily routines.
  • We will then cycle up to a kumquat farm, where you can observe locals working and cultivating the fruit.
  • Next, we will visit a local family, giving you a chance to interact with them, learn more about their culture, and hear about their daily lives.
  • Finally, we will cycle past West Lake for a beautiful view of Hanoi, before passing the railway train track on our way back to your hotel.
  • End of the tour, we will take you back to your hotel.

Tour Includes

  • Professional English speaking guide

  • Quality mountain bike provided

  • All entry fees + free water during the tour

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • For groups of 3 or more people, a support guide will accompany the group to ensure safety and security during the tour.
